title: docs(skills, mcp): teach that an AI service account is refused a confirmation-gated action whatever it sends
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6eUTrsBJsmZzvYABV6AthJ)_

Fixes #32936

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:五处教学文字(objectstack-ai 技能表、MCP 下发的 SKILL.md 及控制台下载镜像、`run_action`/`resume_run` 工具描述、actions.mdx 姿态表、审批 dogfood 文件头)补上同一句话:AI 服务账号用自己的密钥调用需确认的动作时,无论带什么都会被 428 拒绝、什么都不执行,应交给人来执行,或由作者在可无人值守时声明 `ai.requiresConfirmation: false`。
- 为什么改:运行时早已如此(ADR-0151 D3 第 3 条),但已发布的技能仍教所有调用方「带 `confirm: true` 重试」,服务账号照做永远过不去。
- 风险与回滚:零运行时改动,只改文字与两条测试断言;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` 第 204 行表格行;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `run_action` 描述;`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` 的 `run_action` 条目。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/skill-md.test.ts src/mcp-resume-run-tool.test.ts`,预期全绿。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 触及 `skills/**`(Tier H)。契约复审在现 head 已 PASS(评论 6846560754,Head-sha `a7baa0d746269fc53b8a2e7d4cdb3294e58e23c6`),请以 os-zhuang 批准;批准后席位落地。
- 席位意见:同意落地。四个入口与服务账号判定(`principalKind === 'agent'` 且无 `onBehalfOf`)逐一对过代码;复审只有四个 nit,作为接受的偏差。卡评论要的 `list_actions` 标记属运行时改动,已另立 #33067,本 PR 不做。

## What changes

One sentence, in the same terms everywhere: **under an AI service account's own key (an agent acting for itself, for no person) the call is refused whatever it sends and nothing runs: hand the action to a person, or its author declares `ai.requiresConfirmation: false` when it is safe unattended.** The existing teaching for a person and a delegated agent (`confirm: true` after the human approves) stays in every text.

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` — the `list_actions` / `run_action` / `resume_run` row of the MCP tool table.
- `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` — the `run_action` entry carries the sentence; the `resume_run` entry names the same refusal. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts` (the Console "Download skill" mirror) carries the same bytes: the byte-for-byte pin in `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.test.ts` goes red otherwise. This file is outside the claim's listed surface; it is the mirror of `skill-md.ts`, not a new text.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` — the `run_action` description (comment 6839924935), the `resume_run` description, and both tools' `confirm` member descriptions ("Under an AI service account's own key it is not read: the call is refused whatever it sends").
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` (nit D) — the posture table: the `'rest'` row now states the gate it asks for an account under either posture, and the `'ai'` row points to it; the `dispatchAction` example's `confirm` comment says it is never read for an account.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` (nit E) — the file header names the account confirmation rule for the AI service account case (header only; no test code changed).
- Changesets: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`; `'@objectstack/mcp': patch` + `'@object-ui/console': patch` (the mirror).

**The runtime rule, quoted from `main` (c54a23d2), `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`:**

```ts
    if (action?.ai?.requiresConfirmation !== true) return undefined;
    // [ADR-0151 D3 rule 3] An AI service account never confirms for itself:
    // for one, the member is not read at all.
    const account = isAiServiceAccountCaller(caller);
    // Only the boolean `true` attests.
    if (!account && request?.[AI_ACTION_CONFIRMATION_MEMBER] === true) return undefined;
```

It is asked at every door: `packages/runtime/src/action-dispatch.ts` (`if (posture === 'ai' || actionExec.isAiServiceAccountCaller(wiring.ec))`, so REST `/actions` and a host `dispatchAction` on `'rest'` refuse an account too) and `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` `resumeAdmissionRefusal` (`resume_run`). `isAiServiceAccountCaller` is `principalKind === 'agent' && !onBehalfOf`.

**Not changed:** no runtime code; `delete_record` / `delete_records` teaching untouched (a different gate).

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-resume-run-tool.test.ts` — new case: both `run_action` and `resume_run` descriptions keep `confirm: true` and carry the account sentence, and both `confirm` members say the member is not read for an account.
- `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.test.ts` — the action-preference case also pins the account sentence in the `run_action` and `resume_run` entries. The pinned sentence is absent from both source files on `origin/main` (`grep -c` 0), so neither case can pass on the base text.

## Acceptance notes

- **Skill budget (`skills/**`).** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`: 422 → 421 lines, 5776 → 5813 tokens (ceiling 6801). Whole package (sum of every `SKILL.md`): 4597 → 4596 lines, 58697 → 58734 tokens. The row is one table line edited in place; the growth is funded by deleting the pitfall line's restatement of the tool-level `requiresConfirmation` retirement (no execution path read it; `ToolSchema` is strict), which `## Tool` already states. No re-wrap is counted. Net tokens +37, inside the ceiling.
- **Out of scope, reported to the seat:** comment 6839924935 also asks that an AI service account's `list_actions` row carry an `unavailable` marker. That is a behaviour change (today `domains/mcp.ts` sets `unavailable` only from `apiForwardCredentialRefusal`), so it is not built here.

## Verification

Local, on `2126444e` (the change) and re-read on `a7baa0d7` (after merging `main` 64c426ab):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` — 63/63 files, 1094/1094 tests on 2126444e; 63/63, 1097/1097 on a7baa0d7 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck` — exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`) on 2126444e.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — exit 0 on a7baa0d7: `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md is 5813 tokens (ceiling 6801; headroom 988)`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` — `✓ 108 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 106 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`. Every run family exited 0 (`check:skill-examples`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` after building their prerequisites: 344 prose examples type-check; 171/171 files).

<details><summary>NOT MEASURED locally (2), left to CI</summary>

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — exit 3, needs every published package's dist (a full workspace build); this diff changes text only.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` — exit 3, its pinned commit 621a4876 cannot be fetched into this shallow clone.

</details>
